Thank you so much, brother. You uploaded this video randomly, and it happened to reach me while I was studying science and learning about the human body. I started overthinking and feeling anxious, thinking things like, “If I am my brain, then who am I?” and “If everything comes from the brain, then what about the soul?”

I listened to this flute video completely and truly felt something peaceful within me—the feeling that there is a soul inside and that God is with us. Thank you so much, brother. You may have saved me from a lot of anxiety and overthinking. ❤️
